subject: Availability for security walkthrough (SOC 2 / pen test / DPA review)
messages:
From: Julia Kim <julia.kim@clearledger.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security walkthrough request: SOC2 + pen test + DPA review

Hi Soojin,

We're preparing for our vendor compliance review and would like to schedule a combined walkthrough covering your SOC 2 scope, upcoming pen test expectations, and the DPA language. Our security team (cc'd: securityops@clearledger.com) prefers a single session if possible, but we're open to splitting into two short blocks.

High-level asks:
- Quick SOC 2 scope overview (30 mins): what controls are in-scope for hosted API and Dedicated deployments
- Pen test logistics (20 mins): vendor access, allowed test types, and scheduling constraints
- DPA review (15 mins): call out any recent changes in data retention or subprocessors

Proposed times: Mon Dec 20 10:00-12:00 PT or Tue Dec 21 13:00-15:00 PT. We are in PST.

Please let me know who from your side should attend and if you need any pre-read (we can attach our evidence checklist).

Thanks,
Julia Kim
Product Security Manager | ClearLedger
securityops@clearledger.com

——

Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -08:00

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear outline. We can absolutely run a combined session; given the topics I usually suggest a split-window (45–60 mins SOC2 + DPA, then a separate 30-min pen-test logistics block) so participants can drop in for the sections that matter to them.

Availability from our side:
- Mon Dec 20: 10:30–11:45 PT (SOC2 + DPA), 14:00–14:30 PT (pen-test logistics)
- Tue Dec 21: 13:30–15:00 PT (combined, if you prefer single block)

Attendees I recommend: me (security product), Camila (implementation & ops), and Jordan (account lead) — cc'd. If you want the pen-test ops engineer looped in we can add them to the second block.

I can send a calendar invite once you confirm which of the two options you prefer. If you can share your evidence checklist ahead of time that's helpful — I'll also attach our DPA diff and a short evidence matrix to expedite the call.

Best,
Soojin Lee
